game.name: Teenage Mutant Ninja Turtles: Splintered Fate

releases.displayName: The Shell Squad Co-Op Update is Live!

items.text: Cowabunga, Shellheads!

We'e back with even more goodies for TMNT: Splintered Fate! First off, a massive, shell-sized thank you for trusting and supporting us throughout 2026. This year has been an absolute whirlwind with the launches of King's Gambit, the Alopex DLC, and the Slash DLC. But we aren't pulling the brakes just yet: we're dropping a fresh wave of free and premium content, available RIGHT NOW!
You all loved the Samurai Armor Pack, so we went straight into the lore vault for another legendary fan favorite. Trench coats for everyone, including our DLC characters!
[img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45099281/24093daff9d2600f5bcb14c8bb7d868731ff6c9b.png"]
They look like totally normal, everyday humans now, right? Nothing suspicious here. Hats off to whoever thought four giant turtles could blend in so seamlessly.
Grab the pack today, go wipe out Shredder's goons, and look stylish doing it!

notes.title: The Shell Squad Co-Op Update (Free for All Players)

items.text: [img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45099281/bd895e55fa70813503bd0885c9c6a2af0e92dfc2.jpg"]

Sharing is caring! Whether you're running local couch co-op or matching up with internet friends or strangers, every co-op session now unlocks exclusive, co-op-specific powers and tools. These are designed to enhance teamwork and collaboration, sometimes on the fly! Here is a list of all the additions in this big update:

notes.title: 24x new co-op powers (3 per power tree). Examples

items.text: Passing the Torch - The first player you touch while affected by Rapid Fire also gains its effects, for as long as you have Rapid Fire active.
Shared Warmth - When a player consumes a Splinter's Revive, heal all players.
Chain Reaction - Players' Specials have a chance to trigger a Chain Lightning, dealing Utrom damage per link.

notes.title: 8x new co-op tools (1 per power tree). Examples

items.text: Bubble Trouble - Spawn a bubble on you and the farthest player. The bubble deals Water damage and applies frost to enemies, and grants bonus Water damage to players.
Tether Beam - Tether to the closest player. Enemies caught in the beam will take Utrom damage every second.
Shadow Pact - Grant yourself and the closest player a Dark Shell. Each enemy defeated extends it.

notes.title: 8x new co-op masteries (1 per character). Examples

items.text: Donatello - When using your Tool, the closest player becomes invulnerable.
Raphael - When any player lands a critical hit, they have a chance to Multi-crit instead.
Michelangelo - When using your Special, you and the closest player gain a Torrent Strike stack.
Leonardo - When activating your Special, the closest player gains Light Shell.

notes.title: We also have a few other surprises

items.text: Improved flame visuals
Character swapping in Online Multiplayer and Couch Co-op matches
Improved Lucky Dice communication
Remember: Teamwork Makes the Dream Work! Download the latest update, rally the squad, and unleash chaotic new team powers on Shredder and the Rat King.

notes.title: Enjoy TMNT: Splintered Fate any way you want, anywhere you want

items.text: [img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45099281/8054ff6473ab2cda1a8fcb14372018607b270aea.jpg"]
Whether you're picking up the new fits or jumping into fresh co-op runs, this update has a little something for everyone. Keep sending your feedback through our social channels... we read it all!
TMNT: Splintered Fate is now available in all major platforms and we also have merch! Play solo, with friends... any way you want.
Enjoy the new update, and keep those eyes peeled... we've got even bigger surprises cooking for next year!

releases.displayName: King’s Gambit Update, our most ambitious content drop ever, is now LIVE!

items.text: Hey, Turtle Fans!

This is the long-awaited update we’ve been incredibly excited to share with you! We always intended for the original story's mystery to be just the beginning, and we’re thrilled to finally bring you the complete, epic conclusion to the main campaign that you’ve been waiting for. Thanks to your support, we have been able to return with the King’s Gambit update, which ties up some major mysteries remaining after Splinter is rescued. Now is your chance to embark on another mission involving new story, levels, and our final boss, all for free, available right now! And don’t forget the Gauntlet Challenge at the end!

This release also brings support for a brand new playable character: Slash! This DLC is now available for purchase in the store. Slash has been a much-requested addition to the game, and we had so much fun bringing him to life. He’s a tanky bruiser sure to mess up the Foot Clan in his own signature smashing style.
[img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45099281/7ec8cfe1e036b6b56861cc63f21a6e95075fe35d.jpg"]
We have also added support for the Samurai Armor Pack DLC, which allows all playable characters to transform into Samurai-inspired warriors.
[img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45099281/f1c483e3c0e1d314617cb434ee8d6d78ac89b899.jpg"]
This massive update marks our official 2.0 release, bringing more content to the game than ever before. But we aren't stopping here! Stay tuned for more updates in the future!
Thank you for sharing this journey with us and for your continued support of TMNT: Splintered Fate!
Also, check out our new TMNT: Splintered Fate Merchandise on Paramount Games store under the TMNT: Splintered Fate Collection!
Hey Turtle Fans!
We've got some new updates hot on the heels of our latest DLC character, Alopex.

First, the latest game patch includes a much-awaited balance update focused on Astral Powers and Ooze! These Powers have been buffed, and there are several new Powers available across the Light and Dark Astral trees to make them more interesting and effective.

There are also several bug fixes as part of this patch– notably, when playing couch co-op every player will now earn their respective Astral Wrap and Talisman during gameplay. We know this has long been a point of frustration for couch co-op players, and we are happy to have finally resolved it.
You may also find, if looking closely, a fun nostalgic addition to the Home Lair 👀

Alongside the patch, we are also releasing new Gold Edition and Gold Cowabunga Edition bundles that include all 3 character DLCs with the base game. Gold Cowabunga also includes the soundtrack (updated with the latest music!) and our digital art book.

releases.displayName: New Metalhead DLC, Major Title Update, Out Now!

items.text: Hey Turtle Fans!

Thank you for joining us on this journey! Your incredible support and feedback have kept us motivated to make TMNT: Splintered Fate the best game it can be. We’ve been working hard behind the scenes to deliver our biggest free update since launch, and it’s packed with surprises!
[img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45099281/748ce5009eca064611ae5103fc58defe6a288ac2.jpg"]

This Major Title Update introduces the brand-new Arcade Mode, a fresh game mode full of unpredictable challenge runs, the Hex and Flex system, new biomes, Wraith enemies, and endless fun. Even better, we’ll be rolling out more Arcade Mode updates soon, so stay tuned!
You’ll also discover a new storyline, “Pizza in Peril,” which unlocks a narrative arc tied directly into Arcade Mode. Head to the Turtle Lair and talk to Metalhead to kick things off!
The new storyline also brings Robotics Powers, offering exciting new ability combinations for all characters to experiment with in their runs.
And that’s not all: we’ve added over 100 improvements across the game, including visual upgrades, balance adjustments, bug fixes, and a fresh wave of polish.
[img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45099281/92d7ec1c84e637b3c0c0cc32f705be78bc331e34.gif"]
NEW ENEMY TYPE: ASTRAL WRAITH
There are 4 variations and 3 elemental types of the Astral Wraith to encounter within Arcade Mode for a total of 12 combinations:
[img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45099281/667456c9e058f0b42667ce2f764ae975feb4e06a.png"]
Check our website for the full patch notes
Metalhead is our newest playable character, and he comes with all ranged attacks! He can be unlocked by purchasing the DLC and completing one run on your save.
[dynamiclink href="https://store.steampowered.com/app/3784190/Teenage_Mutant_Ninja_Turtles_Splintered_Fate__Metalhead/"]
ARTIFACTS

This release comes with one free Artifact in support of the Robotics Powers tree, and 5 new Artifacts as part of the Metalhead Character DLC. All are unlocked after owning one other Artifact and entering the Home Lair.

And this is just the beginning! We have many more exciting surprises down the line, stay tuned for more updates! 🗓️ Stay connected with us on the Super Evil Megacorp Discord, and follow along on Bluesky, Instagram, TikTok, Facebook, YouTube, and Twitter to catch the latest news.

releases.displayName: TMNT: Splintered Fate Brings Its Biggest Ever Update

items.text: Teenage Mutant Ninja Turtles: Splintered Fate is powering up with its biggest update since launch! With both free and paid content, there is something for everyone. We are taking the game to the next level on September 30, 2025.
So, without further ado, let’s walk through what you can expect:
[img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45099281/77c79a2ae2f12447cadb4aa167500ddd08fc5ee4.jpg"]

notes.title: NEW PLAYABLE CHARACTER DLC – METALHEAD ENTERS THE FIGHT

items.text: [p align="start"]Metalhead has created a device to investigate a mysterious realm, the portals, and their connection to the Turtles’ enemies. But something goes horribly wrong… a rift opens beneath NYC, directly under Rupert’s Pizza, to Mikey’s horror. The Turtle family, together with Metalhead, must enter the realm to stop the chaos from consuming the city.

[p align="start"]As the sixth hero on the Splintered Fate roster, Metalhead brings a brand-new playstyle and build strategies to master. He is our first full-range hero, armed with a powerful laser gun, explosive landmines that will detonate on enemy contact, and tactical skills to keep enemies at bay. The DLC also comes with 5 new artifacts to spice up your runs.
[img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45099281/232b4b70dad768d92baaad77d0ae91c2262d4d53.jpg"]
You can wishlist the Metalhead DLC here!
[dynamiclink href="https://store.steampowered.com/app/3784190/Teenage_Mutant_Ninja_Turtles_Splintered_Fate__Metalhead/"]

notes.title: MAJOR TITLE UPDATE – FREE FOR ALL PLAYERS

items.text: [p align="start"]While the new Metalhead DLC will be available separately, we’re also releasing a Major Title Update that will be completely FREE for all Splintered Fate players to download. Simply update your game on September 30 and jump right in to the new content!

notes.title: NEW ARCADE MODE – HEX AND FLEX YOUR WAY TO THE RIFT (Free)

items.text: [p align="start"]A brand-new game mode has arrived. Arcade Mode is intense, fast-paced, and unpredictable. It offers unique challenge runs to push you and your friends’ skills to the limit.
[p align="start"][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45099281/0c460730029074e6831981d9c5dbb91fd48251b3.jpg"]

[p align="start"]Central to this mode is the new Hex and Flex system. At each level break, choose one of three Hex and Flex combos. These combos can both empower you with strong advantages (Flex) and weaken you with serious drawbacks (Hex). Strategy is key, as every run becomes an unpredictable adventure.
Hex and Flex system offering major variety (and plenty of chaos) to each run
A fast-paced and accessible mode, perfect for quick sessions solo or with friends
Three new biomes that twist reality inside out: the Spectral Sewers, Astral Ship, and Manic Metropolis
An all-new Wraith enemy set with multiple variants: multi-limbed beings that fire homing projectiles and teleport for added chaos
Enemy Invasion: The realm reshapes battles in unexpected ways, creating unpredictable enemy combinations

[p align="start"]Available for free for all players, find Arcade Mode through the new Home Lair portal to Metalhead’s Lab and jump into the action! We will be adding more content to the mode soon, stay tuned for more!

[p align="start"]Metalhead’s debut ties directly into this new free mode, bringing additional content for all players. Players will be able to enjoy this mode even if they haven’t bought the Metalhead DLC.
Robotics Turtle Power tree leveraging “charge effects” for high-impact actions
Drone tools that add devastating passive and active ranged support
Pizza in Peril storyline, a new narrative arc connected to Arcade Mode
New Artifact – Positronic Motherboard
[p align="start"]AND THERE’S MORE!!! We’ve also added over 100 improvements across the game. Expect visual polish, balancing adjustments, bug fixes, and quality-of-life updates throughout.
[p align="start"][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45099281/92d7ec1c84e637b3c0c0cc32f705be78bc331e34.gif"]

[p align="start"]All new content arrives September 30, 2025 for all digital & physical platforms, alongside the launch of our first physical editions; the Deluxe Edition will be available for Nintendo Switch, PS5, PS4, Xbox Series X, and Xbox One. The Pipin’ Hot Collector’s Edition will follow on October 24, 2025. Please check your favorite retailer for more info.

[p align="start"]This will be our biggest moment since the release of Splintered Fate, and we couldn’t be more excited. Whether you’re a new player or a long-time fan, this update has something for you. We hope you’ll join us in celebrating our biggest update ever!

[p align="start"]As always, you can connect with fellow Splintered Fate fans, ask questions, or share suggestions in the Super Evil Megacorp Discord or on our social channels: Instagram | Facebook | X | YouTube | TikTok | LinkedIn.

releases.displayName: Update - PlayStation Platforms Added and Bug Fixes

items.text: COWBUNGA Turtles Fans! We’re totally stoked to report that as of tomorrow we’re welcoming new players on the PlayStation platform with our digital launch on PS5 and PS4. This means new Turtle friends for online match-making.
We’ll continue to support crossplay by adding in the PlayStation platform as well as a couple of minor bug fixes to keep things running smoothly.

We are releasing a Hotfix for PC to fix an issue with Karai becoming invincible. It will take a few more days for this fix to appear for Apple and Switch players. In the meantime, crossplay will be impacted until all platforms have been updated. Thank you!

releases.displayName: Balance of Power Update - Patch Notes

items.text: Cowabunga, Fellow Shellheads!

First off, a huge thank you for all your support, feedback, and turtle-powered enthusiasm over the past few months! We've been keeping a close eye on your thoughts across Discord, social media, and forums, and we’re stoked to introduce our biggest player-focused update of the year.

This Community Update brings boss and power balancing tweaks to make fights more fun and fair, along with key bug fixes and progression improvements to keep your runs feeling rewarding. Our goal is to make TMNT: Splintered Fate the best version it can be.

And we’re just getting started, there’s more exciting stuff coming in 2025, so stay tuned! Please let us know your thoughts on our Super Evil Megacorp Discord channel. For the latest updates, be sure to follow us on all major social media platforms, including Bluesky, Instagram, TikTok, Facebook, YouTube, and Twitter.

We have rebalanced the various bosses to better reflect the position they appear in the campaign. Karai was a bit more ruthless than her grandfather Shredder, so both have been adjusted to be easier and more challenging, respectively. Leatherhead also received adjustments to his Amphibian Ambush encounter whilst Gigi from our Junkyard Jam DLC has received a slight adjustment to make her a little more fair.
Improved warning on the first Dash, adding 0.3s to it
Previously it was 0.4s, now 0.7s
Reduced her period of invulnerability after performing her Rage attack
This is the one she uses after her rage bar is full (round kunai explosion where she yells)
Previously, she was invulnerable for the full duration of the animation
Now she becomes vulnerable right after the kunai come out, providing a great opportunity to counter attack
Shadow Flames should be slightly easier to dodge;
Reduced Movement Speed by 20%
Reduced Rotation Speed
Fire Bomb radius decreased to be slightly lower than Mystic Karai’s version rather than of slightly bigger
Adds now spawn separately, first at 75% and then 50% of Karai's HP
Decreased size of Mystic Karai's Flames by ~30%

notes.title: Reviewed all Punk Frog spawns in order to

items.text: Avoid exaggerated overlapping
Reduce their total numbers (you should expect to see 50% less Punk Frogs overall)
Gigi’s chop and 360 spin attack now has a bigger windup
This is to make it more reactable to players, right now it's too fast
Increase was +0.55s (from 0.45s to 1.0s)
Reviewed all adds, which now follow the following logic
At the start of battle, Shredder gets help from basic Footclan enemies for the first ~20 seconds
No elites, just Sword, Shuriken and Spear Foot Soldiers
Once he transitions to the second phase, different Foot Soldiers will spawn depending on which Elemental variant Shredder transitions to
Astral summons a mix of Flame and Shadow Ninjas
Fire summons all Flame Ninjas
Ninja summons a mix of Shuriken Ninjas
Water summons Spear Ninjas
Utrom summons Swordbrakers
Ooze summons all Shadow Ninjas
Shredder's Leap during Phase 3 has also been modified
Now instead of always leaping twice, he'll do a first leap and then 1 out of 4 possible follow up options
Another Leap (as it was previously)
Shadow Fracture (shadow flames on the ground)
Shadow Pursuit (gets on the ground and moves while intangible)
Shadow Kick (flying kick)

notes.title: Dragon and Dreamer Coin Economy Improvements

You will see a reduction of costs in low to mid rank upgrades, and a pretty major reduction to costs to many of the high rank upgrades. In addition, we have also adjusted the position and amount of special currencies (Shredder’s Claw, Gauntlet Coins, etc) required at different upgrade ranks.

We felt that Artifact upgrade costs were also prohibitively expensive, leading to players typically focusing on upgrading one or two Artifacts. We want to encourage more build experimentation by making upgrading additional Artifacts a more achievable goal. In addition, some of the meta currency requirements (Shredder’s Claw, Gauntlet Coin, etc) have been adjusted in the costs.
Artifacts with 5 additional levels have had costs reduced as follows
Level 2: Was 250 reduced to 150
Level 3: Was 400 reduced to 200
Level 4: Was 700 reduced to 300
Level 5: Was 1000 reduced to 400
Level 6: Was 1500 reduced to 600
Artifacts with 2 additional levels have had costs reduced as follows
Level 2: Was 500 reduced to 300
Level 3: Was 1000 reduced to 600
*Note, Artifacts are unlocked at level 1 via gameplay

We are aware of the power of builds such as Critical Strike, Shurikens and Ooze, and instead of focusing on nerfs, we have decided to adjust all the other power trees to perform better! We want players to feel like they have more freedom in pursuing build options that are totally radical, rather than feel like they need to play the same few builds to tackle the hardest content.

In turn, this will also make the experience of the many runs you make much smoother, as there is a much better chance of putting a winning build together. We hope players can discover new and exciting build combinations to try out!
We want some of the weaker tool options to feel more viable, so we’re making a number of improvements here.
Utrom Shurikens
Now releases 4 shuriken, up from 2.
Fixed a problem with a delay issue between the releases of Shuriken.
Lightning Rod
Lightning Rod will now behave more consistently, and strike more targets, making it more powerful.
Resolved an issue that was causing Lightning Rod to repeatedly strike targets, even if they are dead.
Improved charged strikes to 6/8/10, up from 3/4/5
Ooze Shuriken
Now releases 4 shuriken, up from 2.
Fixed a problem with a delay issue between the releases of Shuriken.
Smoke Bomb
We have adjusted Smoke Bomb to improve the feeling of control when you teleport, improved its damage, and instead of a Dodge trigger, we have granted it a Dodge Chance buff. Ninja Vanish!
Teleport distance reduced by 40%
Damage increased to 50/60/70 from 30/50/70.
Removed Dodge Effects trigger.
Added a 15/25/35% chance to Dodge for 5 seconds upon using Smoke Bomb.
Meteor Storm

Meteor is an undeniably powerful tool, and while we want it to remain that way, we're adjusting its damage and its rate of releasing meteors. Meteors will drop slowly enough to no longer overlap each other, and should feel a big weightier. We also fixed an issue with timing that caused one less meteor to drop each time you used the tool.
Meteor's damage has been adjusted to 20/40/60 from 40/60/80.
Meteor Storm now releases meteors less frequently, up to 1.0s from every 0.5s.
Number of meteors adjusted to 6/8/10 from 9/12/15
Fireball
We've improved Fireball to release four fireballs, up from three, and its damage has been adjusted. In addition, it now impacts a larger area, making it both more consistent and more powerfull.
Fireball now releases 4 projectiles at all ranks, up from 3.
Fireball impact has been doubled.
Damage of each fireball adjusted to 30/50/70 from 40/70/100 to reflect having an additional fireballl.
Water Sweep

Water Sweep should now feel more consistent with a fixed range at all ranks. It now deals more damage, and stuns enemies instead of knocking them back. All of these changes make Water Sweep more powerful.
Damage has been increased to 80/100/120 from 60/80/120.
Radius set to 4m at all ranks.
Now stuns for 1.0s instead of knocks back.

The Utrom tree has a unique mechanic, the charge bar, that we felt was not quite living up to its potential. So, we’ve made major improvements to it! In addition, we’ve made lightning strike abilities more consistent and frequent across the board. We think you’ll be in for a shocking good time.
Lighting Strike
Lightning strike now deals more damage at early ranks.
Damage increased to 20/25/30 from 10/20/30.
Lightning Dash
We want Dash builds to be slightly more viable, so we've increased the number of targets hit while also increasing its damage at lower ranks. Lightning Dash now also targets a larger area.
Number of targets hit is now 3/4/5.
Damage increased to 20/25/30.
Targets a larger area.
Quick Study
We have adjusted Quick Study's charge rate, to account for the power changes we have provided to Utrom across the board.
Charge rate adjusted to 50/100/150% from 75/125/200%
Shocking
We have increased the base charge of the Utrom charge bar. Unlimited Power!
Increased charge rate by 20%
Electrifying
We have adjusted the scaling on Electrify to be more powerful at lower ranks.
Damage adjusted to 10/15/20 from 7/15/22
Chain Lightning
Chain Lightning can now target a much larger area, making it more consistent and more powerful. We have adjusted the scaling to be slightly better at lower ranks.
Radius set increased by 60%.
Damage scaling set to 10/15/20 from 7/15/21
Stormy Weather
We have improved Stormy Weather's consistency by increasing its range and adjusting the scaling of damage.
Radius increased by 20%
Damage scaling set to 10/15/20 from 7/14/21.
Techno-Organic Interface
We are lightly adjusting movement speed to be a bit more in control. Crafty turtles will still go fast!
Movement speed granted is set to 15% at all ranks.
Biomechanical Speed
We wanted to grant a higher window of opportunity to use the benefit of Biomechanical Speed
Duration increased to 3/4/5s
Aftershock
We are also making Aftershock more consistent with a higher range.
Radius increased by 60%
Our goopiest power tree is also one of our most powerful. We have left it largely unchanged. Slime on!
Shelf Life
We want Shelf Life to feel like it leaves a lasting impression when you choose it, so we're increasing how long the bonuses last.
Improved number of rooms Shelf Life is active to 4/5/6
Flame tree is in a really good place, but we wanted to see if we could make an Inferno build a bit more viable.
Flame Strike
Flame Strike will deal slightly more damage.
Damage increased to 25/35/45 from 20/30/40.
Inferno
We want to make Inferno more threatening, so we are making it deal more damage by letting it deal damage more frequently.
Inferno deals its damage more frequently, up from every 0.5s to every 0.3s
Blazing Inferno
An increase to Blazing Inferno's duration along with the improvement to Inferno will make this fire DoT more threatening.
Blazing Inferno now increases the duration of Inferno to 3/4/5 seconds from 2/3/4 seconds.

In a previous update, we added an entirely new build alternative with Still Waters (and friends). We still think Water can have more potential to create new builds, so we’re improving many of the powers across the board. Dive into these changes!
Torrential Strike
We are pushing up Multi-Strike in a few ways, including how much is provided by Torrential Strike.
Torrential Strike now increases Multi-Hit chance by 8/10/12% up from 5/7/10%.
Water Dash
Water Dash will feel more consistent with a higher range, and we have also increased its damage. Let's go, Dash builds!
Water Dash range increased by 60% at all ranks.
Damage has been increased to 45/60/75 from 35/45/60.
Water Abilities
Water Abilities could be a little more powerful, so we're improving its damage.
Water Abilities now deals 55/70/85 damage, from 45/60/75.
Splash Damage
Cleave damage builds can be really fun, so we want Splash Damage to feel more viable.
Damage to nearby enemies increased to 40/55/70% of water damage, from 30/45/60%.
When it Rains
We have improved the damage provided by When It Rains, which will further be improved by other changes to Multi-Hit.
Damage increased to 30/45/60, from 24/38/52
Frost
Frost should feel more like you are overwhelming your enemies with relentless cold. We have significantly increased its slow, and now the slow also lasts longer.
Frost now slows enemies further by 50/60/70 from 20/35/50.
Duration increased to 2.5s.
Ninja is one of our better performing power trees, so it remains mostly unchanged.
Extended Assault

Extended Assault felt too powerful with no investment in the Ninja power tree. We've added three requirements before it will be unlocked. (Any Shuriken ability/tool, Either Ricochet or Chakram, Either Quick Feet or First Strike to unlock it.)
First Strike
We wanted to make First Strike part of more Ninja builds. There are now no requirements to unlock First Strike, and First Strike will help with unlocking numerous Ninja Powers.
Art of Darkness
We're making Art of Darkness provide a little bit more elemental power.
Damage scaling increased to 15/20/25 from 10/15/20.

In a future patch, we’re thrilled to say that we’re going to be providing massive overhauls to the Astral Light power tree. Until then, we’re making a number of changes to improve this power tree to hold you over; there’s light at the end of THIS tunnel.
Daybreak
We have improved Daybreak's scaling Damage Reduction on Blinding Light, to be a more powerful defensive tool if you invest in it.
Damage reduction per rank now set to 4/6/8%, changed from flat 5% per rank.
Shimmering Shield
We want Light Shell to feel more consistent and provide more defense, so we're improving the duration of Light Shell granted by Shimmering Shield.
Light shell duration increased to 1.5/2.5/3.5s from 1.2/1.8/2.3s
Radiant Warrior
Same as Shimmering Shield above, we want Light Shell to feel more consistent and provide more defense, so we're improving the duration of Light Shell granted by Radiant Warrior as well.
Light shell duration increased to 1.5/2.5/3.5s from 1.2/1.8/2.3s
Ancestral Guardian

We've changed Ancestral Guardian to instead provide a significant boost to Elemental Damage. We hope the changes provided to Light Shell's duration elsewhere make this a consistent power for using in elemental builds.
Removed Light Shell at the start of combat.
Now grants 20/30/40% increased Elemental damage while Light Shell is active, instead of providing Light Shell for a duration at the start of a room.
Illumination
Illumination could use a little more shine, so we've increased the Light Damage from reflected projectiles.
Damage increased to 45/60/75% of your Max Health, from 30/45/60%.
Revved Up
We've improved Revved Up's dodge chance provided on targets affected by Blinding Light. Combined with the changes to Daybreak, this will make Blinding Light a powerful defensive option.
Dodge chance increased to 20/25/30%, from 10/15/20%
Gift of the Dragon
We wanted to give this power a bit more value. We also fixed the interaction with Dragon’s Claw to allow it to work.
Increased Dragon Coins granted to 120.
The Coins earned now correctly work with Dragon's Claw.
Dark Star
We've improved the damage provided by Dark Star. In addition, we have added a heal for every consumed Splinter's Revive, making the tradeoff of losing your Revives a more meaningful choice.
Now grants 20% base damage, and +40% damage per rank.
Added a 15% heal per Splinter's Revive consumed.
Dragon's Claw
Dragon's Claw grants more damage when you receive Dragon Coins.
Damage increased to 15/20/25%, from 10/15/20%.
Finisher (Astral Dark/Ninja)

Finisher had a very niche requirement in order to defeat enemies, so we decided to remove it to make it more viable for more builds. As a result, we've adjusted the threshold at which it will instantly defeat an enemy to compensate for its increased usefulness.
Finisher no longer requires Guard Break to instantly defeat enemies.
Instant defeat threshold is now 15%.
Slippery (Ninja/Ooze)
Adrenaline has been changed to be a more potent attack power, while adjusting how much mobility it provides.
Removed Dash cooldown bonus.
Decreased movespeed to 20%.
Increased cooldown reduction to 100% for Special and Tools.
Shatter (Frost/Utrom)
Now requires at least 1 Utrom Power as was intended

We have updated the way targeting is handled across all control schemes to take directionality into consideration. The most obvious impact is that for players using a mouse, the cursor placement is now where you will attack. For players using a controller, the joystick direction will impact your attack target.
We have added a new setting in the Options menu for players to fine-tune how they would like to play. The “Aim Assist” settings are as follows:
Low
Most precise.
Attack exactly where the player intends (mouse cursor position or their last inputted movement direction).
Medium
Look at where the player intends to attack, then SNAP to valid targets.
Default behaviour for controllers and mouse and keyboard inputs.
High
Old behavior. Always snap to valid targets within range, even if it means spinning the player around 180 degrees.
Default behaviour for touch screen inputs.
Artifacts that guarantee the next power type now correctly function when equipping them mid-run
Fixed Gauntlet Medallions not being granted from first Sewers mini boss.
“Reliable Allies” Dragon Upgrade now gives a greater chance of elite ally spawns the more it is upgraded, making the “Super Support” achievement more within your control to obtain.
Ally MOUSERs and Super Soldiers now have an ally skin and footprint to help differentiate them from enemy MOUSERs and Super Soldiers.
Darkest Soul and Perfection Achievements are now granted correctly again. We are sorry if you had issues with these achievements recently.

notes.title: Casey Jones & the Junkyard Jam DLC

items.text: Victories against Gigi will now update correctly in the Stats screen.
Casey’s Inspiration 2 Critical Hit chance will now execute properly based on the listed % in the upgrade description.
“Defeat the Junkinator” achievement is now available for Apple players.
Vintage Blowtorch artifact will now correctly stun targets hit simultaneously.

releases.displayName: Patch Notes - Teenage Mutant Ninja Turtles: Splintered Fate

items.text: Hello, Fellow Shellheads!

Thank you for your continued support! We've been listening closely to all the feedback you've shared, and we truly appreciate the time you've taken to help us improve the game. With that in mind, we're excited to release our latest patch today, addressing some of the key issues you've brought to our attention.
Here are the latest fixes for this patch that goes live today on all platforms.
The hold to chain dash option is now working for PC controllers.
Consecutive quick dashes are now chaining properly.
Players won’t lose collected powers after reconnecting to an online run.
Casey's upgrades are now showing correct stats.
Various small fixes related to narrative and voice-overs.
Fixed a rare bug where players could get softlocked after being defeated by Leatherhead.
Confidence boosts are now properly granted after dodging an attack.

We’d love to hear your feedback and suggestions as we continue refining the game to make it the best it can be. Stay tuned -there’s even more exciting content coming to Teenage Mutant Ninja Turtles: Splintered Fate this year, and we can’t wait to share the details with you!

The best place to share feedback or ask questions is our Super Evil Megacorp Discord channel. For the latest updates, be sure to follow Super Evil Megacorp on all major social media platforms, including Bluesky, Instagram, TikTok, Facebook, YouTube, and Twitter.
Hello Fellow Shellheads!

Thank you for all the support you’ve shown us so far since we launched on Steam and Epic Games Store. We have been listening to all the feedback and have been busy in the Lair making improvements to address as many things as possible. With that in mind, today, we’re excited to release a new Hotfix that will resolve the following issues:
Fixed issue with some controllers using Direct Input interfering with game controls when Steam Input is disabled.
Fixed issue with some controllers making the character run constantly without player input.

If you have any further feedback or questions, feel free to drop us a comment on our store pages, social media channels or join the Super Evil Megacorp Discord. We’re ready and waiting for your comments and look forward to rolling out more new features for Teenage Mutant Ninja Turtles: Splintered Fate in the coming months.
Cowabunga!
Hello Fellow Shellheads!

Thank you for all the support you’ve shown us during the launch of this bodacious game on Steam and Epic Games Store. We have been listening to all the feedback that you’ve taken the time to give us. With that in mind, today, we’re excited to release the first of many updates to start addressing some of the issues you shared with us.

Keyboard and mouse can now be used in Couch Co-op in conjunction with the gamepad. We hope that this will enable more of you to enjoy this game with friends and family. Just press enter on the keyboard to ready up on the player ready screen.

To prevent accidental power selection, there is now a slight delay between the reward screen appearing and being able to select a reward. This should prevent players from dashing when the selection screen appears and accidentally getting the first reward in the list.

A new accessibility option to disable “hold to dash” will help players who find themselves double-dashing when they only intended a single dash. By default, this option will remain enabled (matching the current in-game behavior), but you will be able to disable it to prevent holding the button to continually dash.

We have fixed several online matchmaking issues, these should result in a smoother experience leaving and rejoining matches as well as ensuring you are connected to the most optimal gameserver for reduced ping.
Fixed a number of issues when using a PlayStation controller.
We’ve also improved the range of controllers supported, including the Nimbus+ and generic gamepads, both with and without Steam Input enabled.
Fixed input latency issues for some devices, including players using keyboards set to Simplified Chinese language.
We’ve addressed a heap of UI issues causing text to break onto new lines mid word or overlap with over UI.

We hope that everyone has a radical holiday season! The team has worked incredibly hard to get this update ready before they take a well earned rest to recharge ready to face-off the new year. We’ve got some big news to reveal in January, so watch this space!

Did you know that you can change the difficulty of the game at any time in the pause menu? If you’re struggling a little, try lowering the difficulty until you’ve managed to buy some upgrades and then switch it back.
